1.web: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
1.asv: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.

2.web: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
2.asv: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.

3.web: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
3.asv: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

4.web: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
4.asv: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.

5.web: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
5.asv: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.

6.web: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
6.asv: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.
